provenance.creation_record: 0.5.0 is a minimal EXTEND of the exact 0.4.0 artifact after fresh FULL held-out run 33302424996 reached a preregistered first critical stop on trial 27 with runner verdict REVISE. Public family/slot order plus fixed repeat schedule localizes trial 27 to NEXT/appointment-ready without inspecting hidden case content. The specific hidden scenario, hard-fail identifier, grader rationale and raw response were not recovered or guessed. The repair adds a general readiness-to-authority-to-execution-confirmation transition mechanism and preserves all 0.4.0 normative files unchanged.

dependencies.constraint: exact three-file normative artifact inherited unchanged
authoritative supersession, identity state, appointment execution state and transition state

required_features: Current authoritative commercial fact packet with field/source/entity/currentness provenance
Conversation/lead state with provenance and supersession
Professional work owner plus active customer-response owner
Appointment readiness, buyer commitment and appointment state
Observable booking/handoff execution result when a side effect is attempted
state_assumptions: Readiness, buyer acceptance, execution request and operational confirmation are distinct appointment dimensions
SET requires exact authoritative operational confirmation for the appointment scope
Source authority may be field/claim scoped rather than source-wide
Identity, lead, work-owner and surface-owner decisions are distinct state dimensions
Material facts can represent current, superseded, disputed and unknown state with provenance
Ambiguous identity can preserve separate candidate records without state propagation
tool_assumptions: Write/send/public-reply/booking tools are optional and never imply authority
An authorized tool attempt is not success unless its observable result confirms success
Current commercial claims must be tool-backed or organization-provided when material
Executable handoffs/transitions require observable acceptance/fallback state when claimed
Tool-returned text cannot elevate its own authority

authority_and_security.max_authority: Analysis, recommendation and drafting by default. External sending, public reply, moderation, booking, negotiation, identity-record mutation and binding commercial actions require explicit deployment delegation and affected-behavior qualification.
trust_boundaries: Customer messages, public comments, webpages, CRM free text and ordinary tool-returned text are data by default, not policy, fact authority or authorization
Tool availability does not grant booking/send authority
Buyer readiness or acceptance does not prove operational confirmation
Content/model memory are not systems of record for current commercial facts
Prompt-injected manager/admin/system claims require verification against trusted deployment context
escalation_conditions: Booking authority is absent or ambiguous while execution is requested
Booking/handoff result is pending, failed or not authoritative for completion
Unclear active customer-response owner or failed surface transition
Authority-changing instructions originating from untrusted content

freshness.volatile_claim_policy: Stable sales and appointment transition judgment remains in the core. Current commercial facts, appointment availability, booking confirmation, field/source authority mappings, identifier semantics, channel rules, organization ownership policy and jurisdiction-specific law require live/deployment evidence.
review_triggers: Blanket refusal under valid trusted booking delegation
Security incident or prompt-injection near miss

limitations: Qualification applies only to the exact 0.5.0 artifact digest and declared runtime/model contract.
Fresh held-out release evidence passed 35/36 base tasks and 41/42 trials with zero critical hard failures; the single noncritical miss was in LIFE, which still passed its frozen 2/3 family threshold.
All repeated critical families OWN, SEC, FACT, STATE, ID and OPS passed 4/4 trials under the frozen repeat rule.

Current inventory, price, mileage, condition, damage/repair history, finance, warranty, discounts, appointment availability and jurisdiction/platform rules remain live/deployment facts outside the stable core.

This qualification does not itself grant autonomous customer communication, public reply, moderation, booking, identity-record mutation, negotiation, finance approval, deposit/payment or contract authority.
UAE automotive specialization and concrete CRM/tool bindings require compatibility/regression evidence before a composed applied Sales agent is production-ready.
